Service & support

Ather service in Chennai and beyond

Periodic service, warranty work, battery diagnostics and genuine Ather parts — done in our own bays at all four showrooms, by technicians Ather trained.

Periodic service

Scheduled service as Ather specifies it, with a digital record that follows the vehicle across all four of our showrooms.

Battery health

Range dropped? We read the pack's actual state of health rather than guessing, and tell you what is normal degradation and what is not.

Warranty work

Battery warranty (3 years standard, extendable up to 10 years / 1,00,000 km) and component warranty claims handled here. You do not have to deal with Ather yourself.

Genuine parts only

Ather-genuine parts and accessories. Using anything else can affect your warranty, so we do not.

Software updates

AtherStack updates, dashboard faults and connectivity problems sorted at the bay.

Pick-up and drop

Available in most areas each showroom serves. Ask when you book — it depends on the day and your PIN code.

Before you come in

  • Charge it to at least 30%

    Battery diagnostics need enough charge to run a proper load test.

  • Bring the registration papers

    RC and insurance, for warranty and insurance-linked work.

  • Note when the problem happens

    Cold start, after fast charging, only in the rain — the pattern is often the diagnosis.

  • Empty the boot

    We will need to get into it, and we would rather not move your things.

Roadside trouble? Call +91 89258 15877 first. For a flat battery or a fault on the road, Ather roadside assistance is often the faster route and we will tell you which one applies.
